idea-plugin.name: JSON Path Builder Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A tool window with a JSONPath field and a sample-JSON text area -- type an expression, type or paste sample JSON, and every matched node is highlighted live as you type, with a real match count.

Covers the common JSONPath subset: $ root, .key, ['key'], [n] (array index), .*/[*] (wildcard), and ..key (recursive descent -- every value named key at any depth). An invalid expression shows the real parse error and position instead of silently matching nothing.

100% static PSI analysis of your typed sample -- no external JSONPath library, no network call. Stated honestly: v0.1 does not cover filter expressions ([?(...)]), array slices, union syntax, or recursive wildcard (..*) -- real, documented limitations, not bugs.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry.
